events.summary: Tang Wei, in Kanyou with both fifty-man Tang Champion companies under Duan Jin and Shen Rui, advances toward the Qin military authority handling Ouki's requested preliminary command-qualification review while keeping all one hundred private House Tang veterans together and visible as far as lawful Qin protocol permits. He does not claim Qin office or command, and he stops the retinue wherever lawful protocol requires rather than forcing access.

Tang Wei personally seeks to present Ouki's preliminary command-qualification summons through the first lawful Qin military receiving channel available to him in Kanyou. Both Tang Champion companies remain together under Duan Jin and Shen Rui behind him, still private House Tang troops under Tang Wei's command. Tang Wei claims no Qin office, does not force access, and asks to be directed to the authority handling Ouki's requested review.

Tang Wei presents himself through Ouki's staff channel and proceeds with the preliminary command-qualification review under the receiving staff's lawful procedure, continuing through routine formalities and stopping before any new consequential voluntary choice, appointment, oath, commitment, spending decision, troop transfer, or irreversible escalation.
